caption: The drawing depicts part of a building façade featuring a balcony with intricate ironwork. The ironwork includes a vertical post and a horizontal beam, both covered with swirling vine patterns and leaves, and the balcony railing is adorned with ornate, repeating floral and grape cluster motifs. An open window with multiple glass panes is set in the wall behind the balcony, allowing a view into a dark interior. The wall appears to be constructed of bricks or stones, shown by the lightly sketched outlines. The rooftop is composed of evenly spaced wooden planks, supported by beams, both above the balcony and on the ceiling beneath it. The entire scene is rendered in shades of brown, resembling sepia ink or watercolor, creating a monochromatic effect. The composition is symmetrical with the post near the center and the window positioned slightly to the right.
title: Cast Iron Balcony Rail
